label: Action menu
description: A button that opens a menu of secondary actions — transitions, save, or quick-create forms — such as a "More" menu with Cancel ticket and New child ticket. Items the viewer may not perform in the current state are removed; if none remain the menu is hidden.
usage: Use for 2–8 secondary actions next to a primary button.
Order items by frequency; put danger items last.
Label the trigger "More" or with a noun group ("Create").
constraints: transition:<id> must name a transition of the entity's workflow; it is hidden when not valid from the current state or the viewer may not fire it.
save submits pending edits; validation and data rules run on the server.
quick_create:<id> must name a form view (ViewSpec kind form); it is hidden when the viewer may not create that view's entity.
items: 1–12; danger items require confirm. label is at most 40 characters.

action.description: transition:<transition id>, save, or quick_create:<form view id>.

binding.description: Each item acts on the page's record; items are filtered by state and permissions.

accessibility.keyboard: Enter, Space, or Down opens the menu; Up/Down move; Enter activates; Esc closes and returns focus to the trigger.
accessibility.notes: The trigger has aria-haspopup=menu and aria-expanded; the list is role=menu with menuitem children.

responsive: Below 720px the menu opens as a bottom sheet.

examples.description: More menu with cancel and quick create

confirm.title: Cancel this ticket?
confirm.text: The requester is notified and the ticket can no longer be worked.
